rows.grounds: locative of the seat on which the goddess is placed
compound describing the seat as made or fashioned of gold
compound indicating the seat is encircled by fashioned lion figures

items.question: What kind of seat supports the goddess in this visualization?
premises: The goddess is situated on a seat.
The seat is fashioned of gold.
The seat is surrounded on all sides by crafted lions.
items.inference: The visualization places the goddess upon a gold-fashioned throne encircled by lion figures.
uncertainties: Whether tvaṣṭa refers specifically to the divine craftsman Tvaṣṭṛ or more generally to something fashioned is not explicit.
items.plain_english: She is seated on a gold-fashioned throne surrounded on all sides by crafted lions.
